classifications.policy_clause: Standard Maintenance Policy: Normal Wear, Structural Defects, and Installed-System Failure
conditions: Normal aging or ordinary continuous use
Installed appliance failure without evidence of misuse

classifications.policy_clause: Standard Maintenance Policy: Tenant-Caused Damage, Misuse, and Failure to Mitigate

workflow_rules: A Tenant Responsibility recommendation pauses landlord maintenance planning pending Property Manager confirmation.
A recommendation must never automatically close a ticket, charge a tenant, or deduct a deposit.
Rejecting a recommendation returns the ticket for controlled correction or re-analysis.
